methodologyNotes: Covers residential single- and dual-handle kitchen sink faucets sold in the US at a published MSRP or typical retail price. Includes pull-down, pull-out, and fixed-spout deck- and wall-mounted models. Excludes bar/prep faucets, pot fillers, bathroom lavatory faucets, water-filter/beverage faucets, and commercial-only fixtures. Price is US MSRP or typical retail in USD for the base finish. flowRateGpm is the maximum rated flow in US gallons per minute at 60 psi. spoutHeightIn is the height from the mounting deck to the highest point of the spout in inches. spoutReachIn is the horizontal reach from the spout center to the aerator outlet in inches. sprayModes is the count of distinct sprayhead functions (e.g., aerated stream, spray, pause); 1 means a single fixed stream. activationType is one of manual, touch (touch-on activation), or touchless (motion/hands-free sensor). handleType is one of single-handle or double-handle. mountingHoles is the number of deck holes the faucet requires for installation (1 or 3); single-hole models that ship with an optional escutcheon are listed as 1. valveType is the valve/cartridge technology (e.g., ceramic-disc). bodyMaterial is the primary body construction (brass, stainless-steel, or zinc-alloy). finishOptionsCount is the number of finish/color variants the manufacturer offers for the model. swivelDegrees is the spout swivel range in degrees. lifetimeWarranty is true if the manufacturer offers a limited lifetime residential warranty on function and finish, false otherwise.
